provenance: Inspection was performed locally before executor loss. This record preserves observed conclusions and explicitly identifies missing raw logs and a count conflict.

signature_verification.tool: Android SDK build-tools/35.0.0 apksigner with JDK 17

merged_apk.observed_failure: APK Signature Scheme v3 CHUNKED_SHA512 content digest mismatch

signature_verification.caution: The certificate bytes in the invalid merged APK do not make that APK valid. A valid signature on the splits establishes integrity for those files, not independent proof of publisher identity.

content_comparison.decoded_manifest_and_native_library_comp: Reported matching merged manifest and native libraries in the pre-outage inspection

unresolved.resolution: Do not select a count from memory. Re-enumerate exact .dex paths in both archives before publishing a corrected inventory.

screenshot_evidence.note: Original 51 KB evidence index was not on the inspected remote revision. Do not mistake the 2.4 KB earlier index for complete recovery of all image hashes.
screenshot_evidence.observed_branding_note: REF-021 contains NURIK4PDA text. That observation alone does not establish that the uploaded APK is modified or identify the creator.

recovery_steps: Resolve the three existing Library file IDs, verify their full-file SHA-256 values, and do not ask for reupload before retrieval is attempted.
Safely enumerate ZIP entries and extract only validated relative paths into an isolated reference directory; reject traversal, symlink entries and excessive expansion.
Run apksigner verify --verbose --print-certs separately on the merged APK and every XAPK split, retaining stdout, stderr and exit code.
Run aapt2 dump badging and normalized manifest inspection without executing the reference application.
Compare SHA-256 per exact archive path across the split union and merged APK; recount .dex files explicitly.
Recompute each screenshot's SHA-256, size, dimensions and Git blob ID, then restore the REF-001..REF-023 filename mapping from actual visual inspection.
